title: Gentle activity to prepare for birth

scenes.caption: Check your personal exercise needs
scenes.narration_line: If you have a health condition, ask your midwife which activities are suitable for you.

scenes.caption: Start gradually with manageable activity
scenes.narration_line: If you are new to exercise, start with a small amount, such as ten minutes a day.
safety_points: Do not start a new vigorous activity.

scenes.caption: Keep a pace that allows conversation
scenes.narration_line: Walking can count towards activity; choose a moderate pace where you can still talk.

scenes.caption: Adapt as your pregnancy progresses
scenes.narration_line: As your bump grows, adapt your activity for comfort and avoid pushing yourself too hard.
safety_points: Avoid prolonged flat-back exercise in later pregnancy.

scenes.caption: Drink water, keep cool, and listen
scenes.narration_line: Drink water, keep cool, and stop if you feel uncomfortable, overheated or unwell.
safety_points: Avoid activities with falls or tummy-impact risks.
